config.scoring: sum 1/(60 + source rank), ranks start at 1, absent products contribute zero; exact rational accumulation/order, serialized binary64 score; ascending product_id for equal rational scores
config.comparison: same incomplete-judgment metrics; paired RRF-minus-reference intervals against BM25 and dense on identical locale-normalized query groups; query-weighted overall/per locale plus equal-locale means
config.cohort: exactly 78 original bm25-error-analysis-v1 cases with zero_kind=no_title_token_overlap; this describes judged-candidate titles, not the entire catalog
config.recovery: report known-Exact additions/losses relative to BM25, net query recall wins/regressions, and BM25-zero-known-Exact to RRF-positive queries; no lexical-overlap or nonzero-score rescue claim
config.union_diagnostic: known-Exact coverage in source top-100 union, up to 200 products; candidate opportunity upper bound, not Recall@100 of a served ranking
config.decision: nominate RRF as the next offline development reference only if overall recall paired lower CI >0 against both sources and no locale mean recall regresses versus BM25; otherwise retain BM25. This is not a test-set release or serving adoption
config.hypothesis: complementary lexical and dense candidates may help; no gain is assumed, no weight/constant/depth sweep
config.repeat: two fresh fusion runs must reproduce ranked results, per-query/cohort/union diagnostics, all metrics/intervals and decision; preserve original source artifacts
config.scope: offline fusion only; no re-encoding, new retrieval, ANN, tuning, training, API, LLM judgment or official test access

recovery_and_union_diagnostic.note: Union has up to 200 products, not a served top-100 method. Addition/loss query flags can overlap; net changes are separate.

execution.note: Cached-list offline fusion. Main wall includes input verification, fusion, metrics/bootstrap and diagnostics; excludes import startup and final serialization/artifact hashing. RSS covers input/evaluation state. Neither end-to-end hybrid latency nor serving memory/QPS.

limits: Repeatedly inspected validation and incomplete human judgments only. Unknown relevance stays unknown; coverage is not precision. No adjusted confirmatory significance, final-test release, complete query fix, cross-language, ANN, deployment or online claim.
